#include "earth.h"
#include "noise.h"
#include "gmath.h"
#include "earth_data.h"

#include <math.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

#define DEG (PI / 180.0f)
#define TWO_PI (2.0f * PI)

WorldTime world_time;

#define GAME_MIN_PER_REAL_SEC 6.0f
#define MAX_STORMS 6

static Storm storms[MAX_STORMS];

static float randf(void)
{
    static unsigned s = 987654u;
    s = s * 1664525u + 1013904223u;
    return (float)(s % 10000u) / 10000.0f;
}

float wrap_lon(float x)
{
    while (x > 180.0f) x -= 360.0f;
    while (x < -180.0f) x += 360.0f;
    return x;
}

static float clamp_lat(float lat)
{
    return clampf(lat, -89.0f, 89.0f);
}

static float wrap_rel(float lon, float ref)
{
    while (lon - ref > 180.0f) lon -= 360.0f;
    while (lon - ref < -180.0f) lon += 360.0f;
    return lon;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* embedded real Earth grids (0.5 deg, lon -180..180, lat 90..-90)     */

static void eart_cell(float lon, float lat, int *x, int *y)
{
    float fx = (wrap_lon(lon) + 180.0f) * 2.0f;
    float fy = (90.0f - clamp_lat(lat)) * 2.0f;
    if (fx >= EART_GRID_W) fx = EART_GRID_W - 1e-4f;
    if (fy >= EART_GRID_H) fy = EART_GRID_H - 1e-4f;
    if (fy < 0.0f) fy = 0.0f;
    *x = (int)fx;
    *y = (int)fy;
}

static void eart_sample(float lon, float lat, float *land, float *sdf_cells)
{
    int x, y;
    eart_cell(lon, lat, &x, &y);
    int x0 = x, x1 = x + 1, y0 = y, y1 = y;
    if (x1 >= EART_GRID_W) x1 = 0;
    if (y0 + 1 < EART_GRID_H) y1 = y0 + 1;

    float fx = (wrap_lon(lon) + 180.0f) * 2.0f - (float)x0;
    float fy = (90.0f - clamp_lat(lat)) * 2.0f - (float)y0;

    float l00 = EARTH_LAND[y0 * EART_GRID_W + x0] / 255.0f;
    float l10 = EARTH_LAND[y0 * EART_GRID_W + x1] / 255.0f;
    float l01 = EARTH_LAND[y1 * EART_GRID_W + x0] / 255.0f;
    float l11 = EARTH_LAND[y1 * EART_GRID_W + x1] / 255.0f;
    float l = (l00 * (1 - fx) + l10 * fx) * (1 - fy)
            + (l01 * (1 - fx) + l11 * fx) * fy;

    int8_t s00 = (int8_t)EARTH_SDF[y0 * EART_GRID_W + x0];
    int8_t s10 = (int8_t)EARTH_SDF[y0 * EART_GRID_W + x1];
    int8_t s01 = (int8_t)EARTH_SDF[y1 * EART_GRID_W + x0];
    int8_t s11 = (int8_t)EARTH_SDF[y1 * EART_GRID_W + x1];
    float sv = ((s00 * (1 - fx) + s10 * fx) * (1 - fy)
              + (s01 * (1 - fx) + s11 * fx) * fy) * 0.25f;

    *land = l;
    *sdf_cells = sv;
}

/* landform strength 0..1, 0 = open ocean, 1 = inland */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* continental plates: base altitudes                                   */

typedef struct { float lon, lat, wx, wy, base; } Plate;

static const Plate PLATES[] = {
    {  50.0f,  52.0f,  60.0f, 26.0f,    460.0f }, /* Eurasia      */
    {  16.0f,   4.0f,  24.0f, 27.0f,    700.0f }, /* Africa       */
    {  85.0f,  34.0f,  14.0f, 10.0f,   4400.0f }, /* Tibet        */
    { -98.0f,  46.0f,  26.0f, 30.0f,    520.0f }, /* N America    */
    { -62.0f, -14.0f,  12.0f, 30.0f,    640.0f }, /* S America    */
    { 134.0f, -25.0f,  17.0f, 12.0f,    400.0f }, /* Australia    */
    { -45.0f,  71.0f,  15.0f,  9.5f,  1500.0f }, /* Greenland    */
    { 115.0f,  -5.0f,  15.0f,  6.0f,    300.0f }, /* Indonesia    */
    { 139.0f,  37.0f,   5.0f,  3.0f,    550.0f }, /* Japan        */
    { 122.0f,  12.0f,   5.0f,  5.0f,    700.0f }, /* Philippines  */
    {  47.0f, -19.0f,   4.0f,  6.0f,    900.0f }, /* Madagascar   */
    { 143.0f,  -5.0f,   6.0f,  3.0f,    500.0f }, /* New Guinea   */
    { 173.0f, -42.0f,   3.0f,  2.0f,    900.0f }, /* New Zealand  */
};

static float plate_base(float lon, float lat)
{
    float best = 350.0f;
    unsigned i;
    for (i = 0; i < sizeof(PLATES) / sizeof(PLATES[0]); i++) {
        const Plate *p = &PLATES[i];
        float dx = wrap_rel(lon, p->lon) / p->wx;
        float dy = (clamp_lat(lat) - p->lat) / p->wy;
        float g = expf(-(dx * dx + dy * dy));
        if (p->base * g > best)
            best = p->base * g;
    }
    if (lat < -62.0f) {
        float t = 90.0f + lat; /* distance from the pole (0 at -90) */
        float g = expf(-(t * t) / (14.0f * 14.0f));
        float ta = lerpf(2150.0f, 1100.0f, smoothstepf(-85.0f, -64.0f, lat));
        if (ta * g > best)
            best = ta * g;
    }
    return best;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* mountain belts connected via polyline gaussians                      */

typedef struct { int n; const float *pts; float w; float h; float b[4]; } Belt;

static void init_belt(Belt *bt)
{
    int i;
    bt->b[0] = 1e9f; bt->b[1] = -1e9f;
    bt->b[2] = 1e9f; bt->b[3] = -1e9f;
    for (i = 0; i < bt->n; i++) {
        float la = bt->pts[2 * i], lo = bt->pts[2 * i + 1];
        if (la < bt->b[0]) bt->b[0] = la;
        if (la > bt->b[1]) bt->b[1] = la;
        if (lo < bt->b[2]) bt->b[2] = lo;
        if (lo > bt->b[3]) bt->b[3] = lo;
    }
}

static Belt BELTS[32];
static int belts_n = 0;

static void belt_add(int n, const float *pts, float w, float h)
{
    if (belts_n >= (int)(sizeof(BELTS) / sizeof(BELTS[0])))
        return;
    Belt *b = &BELTS[belts_n++];
    b->n = n / 2;
    b->pts = pts;
    b->w = w;
    b->h = h;
    init_belt(b);
}

static float seg_dist(float lon, float lat, float ax, float ay, float bx, float by)
{
    float dx = bx - ax; /* lon delta wrapped, dateline-safe */
    if (dx > 180.0f) dx -= 360.0f;
    if (dx < -180.0f) dx += 360.0f;
    float px = wrap_rel(lon, ax) - ax;
    float py = lat - ay;
    float ux = dx, uy = by - ay;
    float t;
    float denom = ux * ux + uy * uy;
    if (denom < 1e-8f)
        t = 0.0f;
    else
        t = clampf((px * ux + py * uy) / denom, 0.0f, 1.0f);
    float cx = px - t * ux;
    float cy = py - t * uy;
    return sqrtf(cx * cx + cy * cy);
}

static float belt_height(float lon, float lat)
{
    float total = 0.0f;
    int i;
    for (i = 0; i < belts_n; i++) {
        const Belt *b = &BELTS[i];
        if (lon < b->b[0] - b->w * 2.0f || lon > b->b[1] + b->w * 2.0f ||
            lat < b->b[2] - b->w * 2.0f || lat > b->b[3] + b->w * 2.0f)
            continue;
        float dmin = 1e9f;
        int j;
        for (j = 0; j + 1 < b->n; j++) {
            float d = seg_dist(lon, lat,
                               b->pts[2 * j], b->pts[2 * j + 1],
                               b->pts[2 * j + 2], b->pts[2 * j + 3]);
            if (d < dmin) dmin = d;
        }
        if (b->n == 1) {
            float d = seg_dist(lon, lat, b->pts[0], b->pts[1],
                               b->pts[0], b->pts[1]);
            if (d < dmin) dmin = d;
        }
        float g = expf(-(dmin * dmin) / (b->w * b->w));
        total += b->h * g;
    }
    return total;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* ocean deeps                                                          */

typedef struct { float lon, lat, r, extra; } Trench;

static const Trench TRENCHES[] = {
    { 143.0f,  14.0f, 1.2f, 4800.0f }, /* Mariana       */
    { 128.0f,  12.0f, 1.5f, 3800.0f }, /* Philippine    */
    { 150.0f,  37.0f, 1.6f, 2800.0f }, /* Japan         */
    { 157.0f,  50.0f, 1.6f, 2600.0f }, /* Kuril         */
    { -168.0f, 52.0f, 1.8f, 2000.0f }, /* Aleutian      */
    {  -66.0f, 19.0f, 1.0f, 3000.0f }, /* Puerto Rico   */
    {  -88.0f, 10.0f, 1.2f, 1400.0f }, /* Middle America*/
    {  -73.0f,-25.0f, 1.6f, 1400.0f }, /* Peru-Chile    */
    {  110.0f, -8.0f, 1.4f, 2200.0f }, /* Java          */
    {  173.0f,-21.0f, 1.2f, 4300.0f }, /* Tonga         */
    {  -28.0f,-56.0f, 1.4f, 2000.0f }, /* S Sandwich    */
};

static float ocean_depth(float lon, float lat, float sdf_cells)
{
    float dsea = -sdf_cells;
    if (dsea < 0.0f) dsea = 0.0f;

    float base = 3.0f + 46.0f * powf(dsea, 1.7f);
    if (base > 5200.0f) base = 5200.0f;
    base -= fbm2(lon * 0.030f + 7.0f, lat * 0.030f - 4.0f, 2) * 180.0f;

    float deep = base;
    unsigned i;
    for (i = 0; i < sizeof(TRENCHES) / sizeof(TRENCHES[0]); i++) {
        const Trench *t = &TRENCHES[i];
        float dx = wrap_rel(lon, t->lon);
        float dy = lat - t->lat;
        float g = expf(-(dx * dx + dy * dy) / (t->r * t->r));
        deep = maxf(deep, t->extra * g); /* pull trench floor downwards */
    }
    {
        float h = maxf(base, deep);
        float cap = 1e9f;
        if (lat > 67.0f) cap = 350.0f;
        if (lat < -63.0f) cap = 500.0f;
        if (h > cap) h = cap;
        return -h;
    }
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* rivers carve (real polylines)                                       */

typedef struct { int n; const float *pts; float w, depth; float b[4]; } River;

static River RIVERS[20];
static int rivers_n = 0;

static void river_add(int n, const float *pts, float w, float depth)
{
    if (rivers_n >= (int)(sizeof(RIVERS) / sizeof(RIVERS[0])))
        return;
    River *r = &RIVERS[rivers_n++];
    r->n = n;
    r->pts = pts;
    r->w = w;
    r->depth = depth;
    r->b[0] = 1e9f; r->b[1] = -1e9f;
    r->b[2] = 1e9f; r->b[3] = -1e9f;
    int i;
    for (i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        float la = pts[2 * i], lo = pts[2 * i + 1];
        if (la < r->b[0]) r->b[0] = la;
        if (la > r->b[1]) r->b[1] = la;
        if (lo < r->b[2]) r->b[2] = lo;
        if (lo > r->b[3]) r->b[3] = lo;
    }
}

static float river_cut(float lon, float lat)
{
    float worst = 0.0f;
    int i;
    for (i = 0; i < rivers_n; i++) {
        const River *r = &RIVERS[i];
        if (lon < r->b[0] - r->w || lon > r->b[1] + r->w ||
            lat < r->b[2] - r->w || lat > r->b[3] + r->w)
            continue;
        float dmin = 1e9f;
        int j;
        for (j = 0; j + 1 < r->n; j++) {
            float d = seg_dist(lon, lat,
                               r->pts[2 * j], r->pts[2 * j + 1],
                               r->pts[2 * j + 2], r->pts[2 * j + 3]);
            if (d < dmin) dmin = d;
        }
        float g = expf(-powf(dmin / (r->w * 1.6f), 2.2f));
        if (g * r->depth > worst)
            worst = g * r->depth;
    }
    return worst;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* temperature (needed for ice/snow). cycle-free version                */

static float base_season(float lat, float day)
{
    float lr = fabsf(clamp_lat(lat)) * DEG;
    float base = 26.0f * powf(maxf(0.0f, cosf(lr)), 1.15f) - 0.045f * fabsf(lat);
    float amp = 1.5f + 9.5f * powf(fabsf(sinf(lr)), 1.3f);
    float seas = amp * cosf(TWO_PI * (day - 172.0f) / 365.0f);
    float polar = 14.0f * smoothstepf(58.0f, 76.0f, fabsf(lat));
    float pfac;
    if (lat >= 0.0f)
        pfac = 0.35f + 0.65f * (1.0f - cosf(TWO_PI * (day - 172.0f) / 365.0f)) * 0.5f;
    else
        pfac = 0.35f + 0.65f * (1.0f + cosf(TWO_PI * (day - 172.0f) / 365.0f)) * 0.5f;
    return base + seas + (-polar * pfac);
}

/* temperature used by the world (with lapse + ocean currents) */
static float temperature_at(float lon, float lat, float elev, float day)
{
    float t = base_season(lat, day);
    if (elev > 0.0f)
        t -= 6.5f * elev / 1000.0f;
    t += earth_current_temp_offset(lon, lat);
    return t;
}

/* ice-state temperature, no ocean-current feedback (no recursion) */
static float pure_temperature(float lon, float lat, float elev, float day)
{
    (void)lon;
    float t = base_season(lat, day);
    if (elev > 0.0f)
        t -= 6.5f * elev / 1000.0f;
    return t;
}

float earth_temperature_c(float lon, float lat, float elev)
{
    return temperature_at(lon, lat, elev, world_time.day_f);
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* height                                                            */

float earth_sea_ice(float lon, float lat);

float earth_height(float lon, float lat)
{
    static int order = -1;
    float l, s;
    eart_sample(lon, lat, &l, &s);

    if (s >= 0.0f || l > 0.7f) { /* land (or coast inside) */
        float w = smoothstepf(-1.0f, 1.6f, s);
        w = clampf(w, 0.0f, 1.0f);

        if (order < 0) {
            belts_register();
            rivers_register();
            order = 1;
        }

        float base = plate_base(lon, lat) + belt_height(lon, lat);
        float n1 = 1.0f + fbm2(lon * 0.045f + 13.0f, lat * 0.045f - 7.0f, 3) * 0.5f;
        float mm = n1 * 280.0f;
        float n2 = fbm2(lon * 0.30f + 5.0f, lat * 0.30f + 9.0f, 2) * 26.0f;

        float h = base + mm + n2;
        h = h * w;
        if (h < 1.5f)
            h = 1.5f;

        float cut = river_cut(lon, lat);
        if (cut > 0.0f) {
            float f = clampf(cut / 6.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f);
            h = lerpf(h, -cut * 0.6f, f);
        }

        if (lat < -62.0f) /* Antarctic ice sheet cap */
            h += 900.0f * smoothstepf(-70.0f, -83.0f, lat) + 300.0f;
        if (lat > 58.0f && lat < 85.0f) {
            float dx = wrap_rel(lon, -45.0f);
            float dy = lat - 71.0f;
            if (dx * dx + dy * dy < 150.0f)
                h += 600.0f * expf(-(dx * dx + dy * dy) / 150.0f);
        }

        if (h < -300.0f)
            h = -300.0f;
        return h;
    }

    /* sea */
    if (earth_sea_ice(lon, lat))
        return 3.0f + 0.5f * fbm2(lon * 0.12f, lat * 0.12f, 2);
    return ocean_depth(lon, lat, s);
}

float earth_sea_ice(float lon, float lat)
{
    float l, s;
    eart_sample(lon, lat, &l, &s);
    if (s > 0.5f)
        return 0.0f;
    return pure_temperature(lon, lat, 0.0f, world_time.day_f) < -5.0f;
}

/* snow line in meters for the current day */
static float snowline_m(float lat)
{
    float sl = 5000.0f - 82.0f * fabsf(lat);
    if (sl < 0.0f) sl = 0.0f;
    float seas = (lat >= 0.0f ? 1.0f : -1.0f) * cosf(TWO_PI * (world_time.day_f - 172.0f) / 365.0f);
    return sl + seas * 480.0f;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* precipitation / biomes                                               */

static float coastal(float lon, float lat)
{
    int landn = 0, i;
    for (i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        float a2 = (float)i * 45.0f * DEG;
        float dx = cosf(a2) * 1.6f;
        float dz = sinf(a2) * 1.6f;
        if (earth_height(lon + dx, lat + dz) > 0.0f)
            landn++;
    }
    return (float)landn / 8.0f;
}

float earth_current_temp_offset(float lon, float lat)
{
    float lr = clamp_lat(lat) * DEG;
    float ph = fbm2(lon * 0.050f + 50.0f, lat * 0.050f - 20.0f, 3);
    float g = fbm2(lon * 0.050f + 51.0f, lat * 0.050f - 21.0f, 3) - ph;
    float off = 2.2f * cosf(lr) * sinf(lon * 0.20f + lat * 0.14f) + 2.2f * g;
    if (earth_height(lon, lat) > 0.0f)
        off = 0.0f;
    return clampf(off, -4.0f, 4.0f);
}

float earth_current_speed(float lon, float lat)
{
    float ph = fbm2(lon * 0.050f + 50.0f, lat * 0.050f - 20.0f, 3);
    float gx = fbm2(lon * 0.050f + 51.0f, lat * 0.050f - 20.0f, 3) - ph;
    float gy = fbm2(lon * 0.050f + 50.0f, lat * 0.050f - 21.0f, 3) - ph;
    float s = sqrtf(gx * gx + gy * gy) * 6.0f;
    if (earth_height(lon, lat) > 0.0f)
        return 0.0f;
    return clampf(s, 0.0f, 2.5f);
}

float earth_current_bearing(float lon, float lat)
{
    float ph = fbm2(lon * 0.050f + 50.0f, lat * 0.050f - 20.0f, 3);
    float gx = fbm2(lon * 0.050f + 51.0f, lat * 0.050f - 20.0f, 3) - ph;
    float gy = fbm2(lon * 0.050f + 50.0f, lat * 0.050f - 21.0f, 3) - ph;
    float brg = atan2f(gx, gy);
    if (earth_height(lon, lat) > 0.0f)
        return -1.0f;
    while (brg < 0.0f) brg += TWO_PI;
    return brg * (180.0f / PI);
}

static float precip_at(float lon, float lat, float elev, float day)
{
    float itcz = 23.44f * sinf(TWO_PI * (day - 81.0f) / 365.0f);
    float c = clamp_lat(lat);
    float rf = expf(-powf((c - itcz) / 13.0f, 2.0f));
    float eq = expf(-powf(c / 18.0f, 2.0f));
    float wl = expf(-powf((fabsf(c) - 48.0f) / 17.0f, 2.0f));
    float dry = expf(-powf((fabsf(c) - 23.0f) / 6.0f, 2.0f));
    float coast = 1.0f - coastal(lon, lat);

    float p = eq * 1500.0f + rf * 1200.0f + wl * 750.0f
            + coast * 260.0f - dry * 1100.0f;

    if (rf < 0.2f && p < 450.0f)
        p *= 0.5f;

    if (elev > 0.0f)
        p += elev * 0.06f;

    return clampf(p, 0.0f, 3300.0f);
}

float earth_precip_mmday(float lon, float lat, float elev)
{
    return precip_at(lon, lat, elev, world_time.day_f);
}

Biome earth_biome(float lon, float lat, float elev)
{
    float t = temperature_at(lon, lat, elev, 172.0f);
    float p = (precip_at(lon, lat, elev, 45.0f)
             + precip_at(lon, lat, elev, 135.0f)
             + precip_at(lon, lat, elev, 225.0f)
             + precip_at(lon, lat, elev, 315.0f)) * 0.25f;

    if (t < -12.0f) return BIOME_ICE;
    if (t < -5.0f)  return BIOME_TUNDRA;
    if (t < 3.0f)   return p > 220.0f ? BIOME_TAIGA : BIOME_STEPPE;
    if (p > 1600.0f && t > 18.0f) return BIOME_RAINFOREST;
    if (p > 800.0f && t > 5.0f)  return BIOME_TEMPERATE_FOREST;
    if (p > 450.0f && t > 18.0f) return BIOME_SAVANNA;
    if (p < 230.0f && t > 16.0f) return BIOME_DESERT;
    if (fabsf(lat) > 25.0f && fabsf(lat) < 48.0f && p >= 230.0f && p < 480.0f)
        return BIOME_MEDITERRANEAN;
    return BIOME_STEPPE;
}

const char *earth_biome_name(Biome b)
{
    switch (b) {
    case BIOME_ICE:              return "ЛЕДНИКИ";
    case BIOME_TUNDRA:           return "ТУНДРА";
    case BIOME_TAIGA:            return "ТАЙГА";
    case BIOME_TEMPERATE_FOREST: return "ЛЕС УМЕРЕННЫЙ";
    case BIOME_STEPPE:           return "СТЕПЬ";
    case BIOME_DESERT:           return "ПУСТЫНЯ";
    case BIOME_SAVANNA:          return "САВАННА";
    case BIOME_MEDITERRANEAN:    return "СРЕДИЗЕМНОМОРЬЕ";
    case BIOME_RAINFOREST:       return "ДЖУНГЛИ";
    default:                     return "ОКЕАН";
    }
}

const char *earth_zone_name(float lat)
{
    float a = fabsf(lat);
    if (a < 10.0f)  return "ЭКВАТОРИАЛЬНЫЙ";
    if (a < 24.0f)  return "ТРОПИЧЕСКИЙ";
    if (a < 34.0f)  return "СУБТРОПИЧЕСКИЙ";
    if (a < 46.0f)  return "УМЕРЕННЫЙ";
    if (a < 66.0f)  return "СУБПОЛЯРНЫЙ";
    return "ПОЛЯРНЫЙ";
}

static void blend3(float *c, const float *a, float t)
{
    c[0] = lerpf(c[0], a[0], t);
    c[1] = lerpf(c[1], a[1], t);
    c[2] = lerpf(c[2], a[2], t);
}

void earth_biome_color(Biome b, float lon, float lat, float elev, float day,
                       float *r, float *g, float *bl)
{
    static const float alb[BIOME_COUNT][3] = {
        { 0.92f, 0.93f, 0.97f }, /* ice    */
        { 0.60f, 0.58f, 0.53f }, /* tundra */
        { 0.21f, 0.33f, 0.18f }, /* taiga  */
        { 0.26f, 0.46f, 0.19f }, /* temper */
        { 0.66f, 0.60f, 0.28f }, /* steppe */
        { 0.83f, 0.73f, 0.46f }, /* desert */
        { 0.67f, 0.61f, 0.24f }, /* savanna*/
        { 0.53f, 0.58f, 0.27f }, /* medit  */
        { 0.15f, 0.38f, 0.11f }, /* jungle */
    };
    static const float snow[3] = { 0.93f, 0.95f, 0.98f };
    static const float brown[3] = { 0.60f, 0.48f, 0.26f };

    float c[3];
    float tex = 0.88f + 0.22f * fbm2(lon * 0.9f + 5.0f, lat * 0.9f - 3.0f, 2);
    c[0] = alb[b][0] * tex;
    c[1] = alb[b][1] * tex;
    c[2] = alb[b][2] * tex;

    /* seasonal vegetation: greener in the warm half of the year */
    float cyc = cosf(TWO_PI * (day - 172.0f) / 365.0f);
    float gseason = lat >= 0.0f ? 0.5f + 0.5f * cyc : 0.5f - 0.5f * cyc;
    if (b == BIOME_TAIGA || b == BIOME_TEMPERATE_FOREST ||
        b == BIOME_STEPPE || b == BIOME_SAVANNA || b == BIOME_MEDITERRANEAN) {
        float green = 0.35f + 0.65f * gseason;
        c[1] *= 1.0f + 0.30f * (green - 0.5f);
        c[0] *= 1.0f + 0.10f * (green - 0.5f);
    }

    /* dry season browning */
    if (b == BIOME_SAVANNA || b == BIOME_STEPPE || b == BIOME_MEDITERRANEAN) {
        float pn = precip_at(lon, lat, elev, day);
        float dry = clampf((180.0f - pn) / 180.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f) * 0.8f;
        blend3(c, brown, dry);
    }

    /* snow cover: by altitude + latitude + season */
    float dryf = 0.0f;
    if (b == BIOME_DESERT || b == BIOME_STEPPE)
        dryf = clampf(1.0f - precip_at(lon, lat, elev, day) / 90.0f, 0.0f, 0.4f);
    float sl = snowline_m(lat);
    float sn = smoothstepf(sl, sl + 350.0f, elev);
    sn = clampf(sn * (1.0f - dryf), 0.0f, 1.0f);
    if (b == BIOME_ICE)
        sn = 1.0f;

    /* polar land always snow-covered in winter */
    if (elev > 40.0f && gseason < 0.45f && fabsf(lat) > 66.0f)
        sn = maxf(sn, 0.55f);

    blend3(c, snow, sn);

    *r = c[0];
    *g = c[1];
    *bl = c[2];
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* weather                                                              */

void weather_init(void)
{
    int i;
    for (i = 0; i < MAX_STORMS; i++)
        storms[i].active = 0;
    belts_register();
    rivers_register();
}

void weather_update(float dt_days)
{
    static float next_spawn = 2.0f;
    int i, count = 0;

    for (i = 0; i < MAX_STORMS; i++)
        if (storms[i].active)
            count++;

    next_spawn -= dt_days;
    if (next_spawn <= 0.0f && count < MAX_STORMS) {
        int tries;
        for (tries = 0; tries < 8; tries++) {
            float lon = randf() * 360.0f - 180.0f;
            float lat = (randf() < 0.5f ? 1.0f : -1.0f) * (8.0f + randf() * 15.0f);
            if (earth_height(lon, lat) < -300.0f) {
                for (i = 0; i < MAX_STORMS; i++) {
                    if (!storms[i].active)
                        break;
                }
                if (i < MAX_STORMS) {
                    storms[i].active = 1;
                    storms[i].lon = lon;
                    storms[i].lat = lat;
                    storms[i].radius_deg = 3.0f + randf() * 4.0f;
                    storms[i].intensity = 0.35f + randf() * 0.3f;
                    storms[i].category = 1;
                    storms[i].life_day = 4.0f + randf() * 5.0f;
                    storms[i].wind_ms = 34.0f + randf() * 15.0f;
                    storms[i].bearing_deg = 270.0f + (lat >= 0 ? 15.0f : -15.0f);
                }
                break;
            }
        }
        next_spawn = 2.0f + randf() * 3.0f;
    }

    for (i = 0; i < MAX_STORMS; i++) {
        Storm *s = &storms[i];
        if (!s->active)
            continue;

        s->life_day -= dt_days;
        s->lon = wrap_lon(s->lon - 1.2f * dt_days);
        float pole = s->lat >= 0.0f ? 1.0f : -1.0f;
        s->lat += 0.25f * pole * dt_days;

        float phase = sinf((3.0f - s->life_day) * 0.6f);
        if (earth_height(s->lon, s->lat) > 0.0f)
            s->intensity -= 0.5f * dt_days;
        else
            s->intensity = clampf(s->intensity + 0.03f * phase * dt_days, 0.25f, 1.0f);

        s->wind_ms = 33.0f + 58.0f * s->intensity;
        int cat = 1 + (int)(s->intensity * 4.99f);
        if (cat > 5) cat = 5;
        s->category = cat;

        if (s->life_day <= 0.0f || s->intensity < 0.08f)
            s->active = 0;
    }
}

Storm earth_nearest_cyclone(float lon, float lat, float *dist_deg)
{
    Storm best;
    best.active = 0;
    float bd = 1e9f;
    int i;

    for (i = 0; i < MAX_STORMS; i++) {
        Storm *s = &storms[i];
        if (!s->active)
            continue;
        float dx = wrap_lon(s->lon - lon);
        float dy = s->lat - lat;
        float d = sqrtf(dx * dx + dy * dy);
        if (d < bd) {
            bd = d;
            best = *s;
        }
    }
    *dist_deg = bd;
    return best;
}

void game_tick(float real_dt)
{
    float mins = real_dt * GAME_MIN_PER_REAL_SEC;
    world_time.day_f += mins / 1440.0f;

    while (world_time.day_f >= 366.0f) {
        world_time.day_f -= 365.0f;
        world_time.year++;
    }
    if (world_time.day_f < 1.0f)
        world_time.day_f = 1.0f;

    int d = (int)world_time.day_f;
    if (d > 365) d = 365;
    world_time.day = d;

    float hfrac = (world_time.day_f - (float)d) * 24.0f;
    int h = (int)hfrac;
    if (h > 23) h = 23;
    world_time.hour = h;
    world_time.minute = (int)((hfrac - (float)h) * 60.0f);
}

Vec3 earth_sun_dir(float lat)
{
    float dl = 23.44f * DEG * sinf(TWO_PI * (world_time.day_f - 81.0f) / 365.0f);
    float lr = clamp_lat(lat) * DEG;
    float hour = world_time.hour + world_time.minute / 60.0f;
    float hr = (hour - 12.0f) * 15.0f * DEG;

    float sinel = sinf(dl) * sinf(lr) + cosf(dl) * cosf(lr) * cosf(hr);
    float el = asinf(clampf(sinel, -1.0f, 1.0f));
    float cel = cosf(el);
    float cosL = cosf(lr);

    float ca = 1.0f;
    if (cel > 1e-4f && cosL > 1e-4f)
        ca = (sinf(dl) - sinf(el) * sinf(lr)) / (cel * cosL);
    ca = clampf(ca, -1.0f, 1.0f);
    float sa = cel > 1e-4f ? cosf(dl) * sinf(hr) / cel : 0.0f;
    float az = atan2f(sa, ca);

    return v3(cel * sinf(az), sinf(el), cel * cosf(az));
}

void earth_light(float e, float rain,
                 float *ambient, float *diffuse,
                 float *top_r, float *top_g, float *top_b,
                 float *hor_r, float *hor_g, float *hor_b)
{
    float t = smoothstepf(-0.18f, 0.12f, e);
    float tn = smoothstepf(-0.18f, -0.05f, e);

    float dr = 88.0f, dg = 150.0f, db = 230.0f;
    float dh = 190.0f, dhh = 212.0f, dhb = 236.0f;
    float nr = 6.0f, ng = 10.0f, nb = 26.0f;
    float nh = 10.0f, nhh = 16.0f, nhb = 42.0f;
    float tr2 = 36.0f + 52.0f * (1.0f - tn), tg = 30.0f + 30.0f * tn, tb = 44.0f + 70.0f * tn;
    float thr = 250.0f, thg = 150.0f, thb = 60.0f;

    float top_c[3] = { lerpf(nr, tr2, tn), lerpf(ng, tg, tn), lerpf(nb, tb, tn) };
    float hor_c[3] = { lerpf(nh, thr, tn), lerpf(nhh, thg, tn), lerpf(nhb, thb, tn) };

    top_c[0] = lerpf(top_c[0], dr, t);
    top_c[1] = lerpf(top_c[1], dg, t);
    top_c[2] = lerpf(top_c[2], db, t);
    hor_c[0] = lerpf(hor_c[0], dh, t);
    hor_c[1] = lerpf(hor_c[1], dhh, t);
    hor_c[2] = lerpf(hor_c[2], dhb, t);

    *ambient = lerpf(0.10f, 0.42f, t);
    *diffuse = lerpf(0.06f, 0.80f, t);

    if (rain > 0.0f) {
        float g2[3] = { 0.78f, 0.79f, 0.80f };
        top_c[0] = lerpf(top_c[0], g2[0] * 120.0f, rain);
        top_c[1] = lerpf(top_c[1], g2[1] * 120.0f, rain);
        top_c[2] = lerpf(top_c[2], g2[2] * 120.0f, rain);
        hor_c[0] = lerpf(hor_c[0], g2[0] * 130.0f, rain);
        hor_c[1] = lerpf(hor_c[1], g2[1] * 130.0f, rain);
        hor_c[2] = lerpf(hor_c[2], g2[2] * 130.0f, rain);
        *ambient -= 0.12f * rain;
        *diffuse -= 0.35f * rain;
        if (*ambient < 0.05f) *ambient = 0.05f;
        if (*diffuse < 0.05f) *diffuse = 0.05f;
    }

    *top_r = top_c[0];
    *top_g = top_c[1];
    *top_b = top_c[2];
    *hor_r = hor_c[0];
    *hor_g = hor_c[1];
    *hor_b = hor_c[2];
}

FILE: Anti-world/src/earth.c.orig

#include "earth.h"
#include "noise.h"
#include "gmath.h"
#include "earth_data.h"

#include <math.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

#define DEG (PI / 180.0f)
#define TWO_PI (2.0f * PI)

WorldTime world_time;

#define GAME_MIN_PER_REAL_SEC 6.0f
#define MAX_STORMS 6

static Storm storms[MAX_STORMS];

static float randf(void)
{
    static unsigned s = 987654u;
    s = s * 1664525u + 1013904223u;
    return (float)(s % 10000u) / 10000.0f;
}

float wrap_lon(float x)
{
    while (x > 180.0f) x -= 360.0f;
    while (x < -180.0f) x += 360.0f;
    return x;
}

static float clamp_lat(float lat)
{
    return clampf(lat, -89.0f, 89.0f);
}

static float wrap_rel(float lon, float ref)
{
    while (lon - ref > 180.0f) lon -= 360.0f;
    while (lon - ref < -180.0f) lon += 360.0f;
    return lon;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* embedded real Earth grids (0.5 deg, lon -180..180, lat 90..-90)     */

static void eart_cell(float lon, float lat, int *x, int *y)
{
    float fx = (wrap_lon(lon) + 180.0f) * 2.0f;
    float fy = (90.0f - clamp_lat(lat)) * 2.0f;
    if (fx >= EART_GRID_W) fx = EART_GRID_W - 1e-4f;
    if (fy >= EART_GRID_H) fy = EART_GRID_H - 1e-4f;
    if (fy < 0.0f) fy = 0.0f;
    *x = (int)fx;
    *y = (int)fy;
}

static void eart_sample(float lon, float lat, float *land, float *sdf_cells)
{
    int x, y;
    eart_cell(lon, lat, &x, &y);
    int x0 = x, x1 = x + 1, y0 = y, y1 = y;
    if (x1 >= EART_GRID_W) x1 = 0;
    if (y0 + 1 < EART_GRID_H) y1 = y0 + 1;

    float fx = (wrap_lon(lon) + 180.0f) * 2.0f - (float)x0;
    float fy = (90.0f - clamp_lat(lat)) * 2.0f - (float)y0;

    float l00 = EARTH_LAND[y0 * EART_GRID_W + x0] / 255.0f;
    float l10 = EARTH_LAND[y0 * EART_GRID_W + x1] / 255.0f;
    float l01 = EARTH_LAND[y1 * EART_GRID_W + x0] / 255.0f;
    float l11 = EARTH_LAND[y1 * EART_GRID_W + x1] / 255.0f;
    float l = (l00 * (1 - fx) + l10 * fx) * (1 - fy)
            + (l01 * (1 - fx) + l11 * fx) * fy;

    int8_t s00 = (int8_t)EARTH_SDF[y0 * EART_GRID_W + x0];
    int8_t s10 = (int8_t)EARTH_SDF[y0 * EART_GRID_W + x1];
    int8_t s01 = (int8_t)EARTH_SDF[y1 * EART_GRID_W + x0];
    int8_t s11 = (int8_t)EARTH_SDF[y1 * EART_GRID_W + x1];
    float sv = ((s00 * (1 - fx) + s10 * fx) * (1 - fy)
              + (s01 * (1 - fx) + s11 * fx) * fy) * 0.25f;

    *land = l;
    *sdf_cells = sv;
}

/* landform strength 0..1, 0 = open ocean, 1 = inland */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* continental plates: base altitudes                                   */

typedef struct { float lon, lat, wx, wy, base; } Plate;

static const Plate PLATES[] = {
    {  50.0f,  52.0f,  60.0f, 26.0f,    460.0f }, /* Eurasia      */
    {  16.0f,   4.0f,  24.0f, 27.0f,    700.0f }, /* Africa       */
    {  85.0f,  34.0f,  14.0f, 10.0f,   4400.0f }, /* Tibet        */
    { -98.0f,  46.0f,  26.0f, 30.0f,    520.0f }, /* N America    */
    { -62.0f, -14.0f,  12.0f, 30.0f,    640.0f }, /* S America    */
    { 134.0f, -25.0f,  17.0f, 12.0f,    400.0f }, /* Australia    */
    { -45.0f,  71.0f,  15.0f,  9.5f,  1500.0f }, /* Greenland    */
    { 115.0f,  -5.0f,  15.0f,  6.0f,    300.0f }, /* Indonesia    */
    { 139.0f,  37.0f,   5.0f,  3.0f,    550.0f }, /* Japan        */
    { 122.0f,  12.0f,   5.0f,  5.0f,    700.0f }, /* Philippines  */
    {  47.0f, -19.0f,   4.0f,  6.0f,    900.0f }, /* Madagascar   */
    { 143.0f,  -5.0f,   6.0f,  3.0f,    500.0f }, /* New Guinea   */
    { 173.0f, -42.0f,   3.0f,  2.0f,    900.0f }, /* New Zealand  */
};

static float plate_base(float lon, float lat)
{
    float best = 350.0f;
    unsigned i;
    for (i = 0; i < sizeof(PLATES) / sizeof(PLATES[0]); i++) {
        const Plate *p = &PLATES[i];
        float dx = wrap_rel(lon, p->lon) / p->wx;
        float dy = (clamp_lat(lat) - p->lat) / p->wy;
        float g = expf(-(dx * dx + dy * dy));
        if (p->base * g > best)
            best = p->base * g;
    }
    if (lat < -62.0f) {
        float t = 90.0f + lat; /* distance from the pole (0 at -90) */
        float g = expf(-(t * t) / (14.0f * 14.0f));
        float ta = lerpf(2150.0f, 1100.0f, smoothstepf(-85.0f, -64.0f, lat));
        if (ta * g > best)
            best = ta * g;
    }
    return best;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* mountain belts connected via polyline gaussians                      */

typedef struct { int n; const float *pts; float w; float h; float b[4]; } Belt;

static void init_belt(Belt *bt)
{
    int i;
    bt->b[0] = 1e9f; bt->b[1] = -1e9f;
    bt->b[2] = 1e9f; bt->b[3] = -1e9f;
    for (i = 0; i < bt->n; i++) {
        float la = bt->pts[2 * i], lo = bt->pts[2 * i + 1];
        if (la < bt->b[0]) bt->b[0] = la;
        if (la > bt->b[1]) bt->b[1] = la;
        if (lo < bt->b[2]) bt->b[2] = lo;
        if (lo > bt->b[3]) bt->b[3] = lo;
    }
}

static Belt BELTS[32];
static int belts_n = 0;

static void belt_add(int n, const float *pts, float w, float h)
{
    if (belts_n >= (int)(sizeof(BELTS) / sizeof(BELTS[0])))
        return;
    Belt *b = &BELTS[belts_n++];
    b->n = n / 2;
    b->pts = pts;
    b->w = w;
    b->h = h;
    init_belt(b);
}

static float seg_dist(float lon, float lat, float ax, float ay, float bx, float by)
{
    float dx = wrap_rel(bx, ax); /* lon delta wrapped, dateline-safe */
    float rx = ax + wrap_rel(lon, ax);
    float px = rx - ax;
    float py = lat - ay;
    float ux = dx, uy = by - ay;
    float t;
    float denom = ux * ux + uy * uy;
    if (denom < 1e-8f)
        t = 0.0f;
    else
        t = clampf((px * ux + py * uy) / denom, 0.0f, 1.0f);
    float cx = px - t * ux;
    float cy = py - t * uy;
    return sqrtf(cx * cx + cy * cy);
}

static float belt_height(float lon, float lat)
{
    float total = 0.0f;
    int i;
    for (i = 0; i < belts_n; i++) {
        const Belt *b = &BELTS[i];
        if (lon < b->b[0] - b->w * 2.0f || lon > b->b[1] + b->w * 2.0f ||
            lat < b->b[2] - b->w * 2.0f || lat > b->b[3] + b->w * 2.0f)
            continue;
        float dmin = 1e9f;
        int j;
        for (j = 0; j + 1 < b->n; j++) {
            float d = seg_dist(lon, lat,
                               b->pts[2 * j], b->pts[2 * j + 1],
                               b->pts[2 * j + 2], b->pts[2 * j + 3]);
            if (d < dmin) dmin = d;
        }
        if (b->n == 1) {
            float d = seg_dist(lon, lat, b->pts[0], b->pts[1],
                               b->pts[0], b->pts[1]);
            if (d < dmin) dmin = d;
        }
        float g = expf(-(dmin * dmin) / (b->w * b->w));
        total += b->h * g;
    }
    return total;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* ocean deeps                                                          */

typedef struct { float lon, lat, r, extra; } Trench;

static const Trench TRENCHES[] = {
    { 143.0f,  14.0f, 1.2f, 4800.0f }, /* Mariana       */
    { 128.0f,  12.0f, 1.5f, 3800.0f }, /* Philippine    */
    { 150.0f,  37.0f, 1.6f, 2800.0f }, /* Japan         */
    { 157.0f,  50.0f, 1.6f, 2600.0f }, /* Kuril         */
    { -168.0f, 52.0f, 1.8f, 2000.0f }, /* Aleutian      */
    {  -66.0f, 19.0f, 1.0f, 3000.0f }, /* Puerto Rico   */
    {  -88.0f, 10.0f, 1.2f, 1400.0f }, /* Middle America*/
    {  -73.0f,-25.0f, 1.6f, 1400.0f }, /* Peru-Chile    */
    {  110.0f, -8.0f, 1.4f, 2200.0f }, /* Java          */
    {  173.0f,-21.0f, 1.2f, 4300.0f }, /* Tonga         */
    {  -28.0f,-56.0f, 1.4f, 2000.0f }, /* S Sandwich    */
};

static float ocean_depth(float lon, float lat, float sdf_cells)
{
    float dsea = -sdf_cells;
    if (dsea < 0.0f) dsea = 0.0f;

    float base = 3.0f + 46.0f * powf(dsea, 1.7f);
    if (base > 5200.0f) base = 5200.0f;
    base -= fbm2(lon * 0.030f + 7.0f, lat * 0.030f - 4.0f, 2) * 180.0f;

    float deep = base;
    unsigned i;
    for (i = 0; i < sizeof(TRENCHES) / sizeof(TRENCHES[0]); i++) {
        const Trench *t = &TRENCHES[i];
        float dx = wrap_rel(lon, t->lon);
        float dy = lat - t->lat;
        float g = expf(-(dx * dx + dy * dy) / (t->r * t->r));
        deep = maxf(deep, t->extra * g); /* pull trench floor downwards */
    }
    {
        float h = maxf(base, deep);
        float cap = 1e9f;
        if (lat > 67.0f) cap = 350.0f;
        if (lat < -63.0f) cap = 500.0f;
        if (h > cap) h = cap;
        return -h;
    }
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* rivers carve (real polylines)                                       */

typedef struct { int n; const float *pts; float w, depth; float b[4]; } River;

static River RIVERS[20];
static int rivers_n = 0;

static void river_add(int n, const float *pts, float w, float depth)
{
    if (rivers_n >= (int)(sizeof(RIVERS) / sizeof(RIVERS[0])))
        return;
    River *r = &RIVERS[rivers_n++];
    r->n = n;
    r->pts = pts;
    r->w = w;
    r->depth = depth;
    r->b[0] = 1e9f; r->b[1] = -1e9f;
    r->b[2] = 1e9f; r->b[3] = -1e9f;
    int i;
    for (i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        float la = pts[2 * i], lo = pts[2 * i + 1];
        if (la < r->b[0]) r->b[0] = la;
        if (la > r->b[1]) r->b[1] = la;
        if (lo < r->b[2]) r->b[2] = lo;
        if (lo > r->b[3]) r->b[3] = lo;
    }
}

static float river_cut(float lon, float lat)
{
    float worst = 0.0f;
    int i;
    for (i = 0; i < rivers_n; i++) {
        const River *r = &RIVERS[i];
        if (lon < r->b[0] - r->w || lon > r->b[1] + r->w ||
            lat < r->b[2] - r->w || lat > r->b[3] + r->w)
            continue;
        float dmin = 1e9f;
        int j;
        for (j = 0; j + 1 < r->n; j++) {
            float d = seg_dist(lon, lat,
                               r->pts[2 * j], r->pts[2 * j + 1],
                               r->pts[2 * j + 2], r->pts[2 * j + 3]);
            if (d < dmin) dmin = d;
        }
        float g = expf(-powf(dmin / (r->w * 1.6f), 2.2f));
        if (g * r->depth > worst)
            worst = g * r->depth;
    }
    return worst;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* temperature (needed for ice/snow). cycle-free version                */

static float base_season(float lat, float day)
{
    float lr = fabsf(clamp_lat(lat)) * DEG;
    float base = 26.0f * powf(maxf(0.0f, cosf(lr)), 1.15f) - 0.045f * fabsf(lat);
    float amp = 1.5f + 9.5f * powf(fabsf(sinf(lr)), 1.3f);
    float seas = amp * cosf(TWO_PI * (day - 172.0f) / 365.0f);
    float polar = 14.0f * smoothstepf(58.0f, 76.0f, fabsf(lat));
    float pfac;
    if (lat >= 0.0f)
        pfac = 0.35f + 0.65f * (1.0f - cosf(TWO_PI * (day - 172.0f) / 365.0f)) * 0.5f;
    else
        pfac = 0.35f + 0.65f * (1.0f + cosf(TWO_PI * (day - 172.0f) / 365.0f)) * 0.5f;
    return base + seas + (-polar * pfac);
}

/* temperature used by the world (with lapse + ocean currents) */
static float temperature_at(float lon, float lat, float elev, float day)
{
    float t = base_season(lat, day);
    if (elev > 0.0f)
        t -= 6.5f * elev / 1000.0f;
    t += earth_current_temp_offset(lon, lat);
    return t;
}

/* ice-state temperature, no ocean-current feedback (no recursion) */
static float pure_temperature(float lon, float lat, float elev, float day)
{
    (void)lon;
    float t = base_season(lat, day);
    if (elev > 0.0f)
        t -= 6.5f * elev / 1000.0f;
    return t;
}

float earth_temperature_c(float lon, float lat, float elev)
{
    return temperature_at(lon, lat, elev, world_time.day_f);
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* height                                                            */

float earth_sea_ice(float lon, float lat);

float earth_height(float lon, float lat)
{
    static int order = -1;
    float l, s;
    eart_sample(lon, lat, &l, &s);

    if (s >= 0.0f || l > 0.7f) { /* land (or coast inside) */
        float w = smoothstepf(-1.0f, 1.6f, s);
        w = clampf(w, 0.0f, 1.0f);

        if (order < 0) {
            belts_register();
            rivers_register();
            order = 1;
        }

        float base = plate_base(lon, lat) + belt_height(lon, lat);
        float n1 = 1.0f + fbm2(lon * 0.045f + 13.0f, lat * 0.045f - 7.0f, 3) * 0.5f;
        float mm = n1 * 280.0f;
        float n2 = fbm2(lon * 0.30f + 5.0f, lat * 0.30f + 9.0f, 2) * 26.0f;

        float h = base + mm + n2;
        h = h * w;

        float cut = river_cut(lon, lat);
        if (cut > 0.0f) {
            float f = clampf(cut / 6.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f);
            h = lerpf(h, -cut * 0.6f, f);
        }

        if (lat < -62.0f) /* Antarctic ice sheet cap */
            h += 900.0f * smoothstepf(-70.0f, -83.0f, lat) + 300.0f;
        if (lat > 58.0f && lat < 85.0f) {
            float dx = wrap_rel(lon, -45.0f);
            float dy = lat - 71.0f;
            if (dx * dx + dy * dy < 150.0f)
                h += 600.0f * expf(-(dx * dx + dy * dy) / 150.0f);
        }

        if (h < 1.5f)
            h = 1.5f;
        return h;
    }

    /* sea */
    if (earth_sea_ice(lon, lat))
        return 3.0f + 0.5f * fbm2(lon * 0.12f, lat * 0.12f, 2);
    return ocean_depth(lon, lat, s);
}

float earth_sea_ice(float lon, float lat)
{
    float l, s;
    eart_sample(lon, lat, &l, &s);
    if (s > 0.5f)
        return 0.0f;
    return pure_temperature(lon, lat, 0.0f, world_time.day_f) < -5.0f;
}

/* snow line in meters for the current day */
static float snowline_m(float lat)
{
    float sl = 5000.0f - 82.0f * fabsf(lat);
    if (sl < 0.0f) sl = 0.0f;
    float seas = (lat >= 0.0f ? 1.0f : -1.0f) * cosf(TWO_PI * (world_time.day_f - 172.0f) / 365.0f);
    return sl + seas * 480.0f;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* precipitation / biomes                                               */

static float coastal(float lon, float lat)
{
    int landn = 0, i;
    for (i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        float a2 = (float)i * 45.0f * DEG;
        float dx = cosf(a2) * 1.6f;
        float dz = sinf(a2) * 1.6f;
        if (earth_height(lon + dx, lat + dz) > 0.0f)
            landn++;
    }
    return (float)landn / 8.0f;
}

float earth_current_temp_offset(float lon, float lat)
{
    float lr = clamp_lat(lat) * DEG;
    float ph = fbm2(lon * 0.050f + 50.0f, lat * 0.050f - 20.0f, 3);
    float g = fbm2(lon * 0.050f + 51.0f, lat * 0.050f - 21.0f, 3) - ph;
    float off = 2.2f * cosf(lr) * sinf(lon * 0.20f + lat * 0.14f) + 2.2f * g;
    if (earth_height(lon, lat) > 0.0f)
        off = 0.0f;
    return clampf(off, -4.0f, 4.0f);
}

float earth_current_speed(float lon, float lat)
{
    float ph = fbm2(lon * 0.050f + 50.0f, lat * 0.050f - 20.0f, 3);
    float gx = fbm2(lon * 0.050f + 51.0f, lat * 0.050f - 20.0f, 3) - ph;
    float gy = fbm2(lon * 0.050f + 50.0f, lat * 0.050f - 21.0f, 3) - ph;
    float s = sqrtf(gx * gx + gy * gy) * 6.0f;
    if (earth_height(lon, lat) > 0.0f)
        return 0.0f;
    return clampf(s, 0.0f, 2.5f);
}

float earth_current_bearing(float lon, float lat)
{
    float ph = fbm2(lon * 0.050f + 50.0f, lat * 0.050f - 20.0f, 3);
    float gx = fbm2(lon * 0.050f + 51.0f, lat * 0.050f - 20.0f, 3) - ph;
    float gy = fbm2(lon * 0.050f + 50.0f, lat * 0.050f - 21.0f, 3) - ph;
    float brg = atan2f(gx, gy);
    if (earth_height(lon, lat) > 0.0f)
        return -1.0f;
    while (brg < 0.0f) brg += TWO_PI;
    return brg * (180.0f / PI);
}

static float precip_at(float lon, float lat, float elev, float day)
{
    float itcz = 23.44f * sinf(TWO_PI * (day - 81.0f) / 365.0f);
    float rf = expf(-powf((clamp_lat(lat) - itcz) / 13.0f, 2.0f));
    float coast = 1.0f - coastal(lon, lat);
    float t = temperature_at(lon, lat, elev, day);
    float p = 55.0f + rf * 230.0f + coast * 120.0f;

    if (elev > 0.0f) {
        if ((itcz > 0.0f && lat > 0.0f) || (itcz < 0.0f && lat < 0.0f))
            p += 60.0f;
        else
            p *= 0.85f;
    }

    if (t > 20.0f && fabsf(itcz - lat) > 20.0f && rf < 0.35f && coast < 0.45f)
        p *= 0.12f;
    if (t < -5.0f && rf < 0.3f)
        p *= 0.5f;

    return clampf(p, 0.0f, 400.0f);
}

float earth_precip_mmday(float lon, float lat, float elev)
{
    return precip_at(lon, lat, elev, world_time.day_f);
}

Biome earth_biome(float lon, float lat, float elev)
{
    float t = temperature_at(lon, lat, elev, 172.0f);
    float p = (precip_at(lon, lat, elev, 45.0f)
             + precip_at(lon, lat, elev, 135.0f)
             + precip_at(lon, lat, elev, 225.0f)
             + precip_at(lon, lat, elev, 315.0f)) * 0.25f;

    if (t < -12.0f) return BIOME_ICE;
    if (t < -5.0f)  return BIOME_TUNDRA;
    if (t < 3.0f)   return p > 220.0f ? BIOME_TAIGA : BIOME_STEPPE;
    if (p > 1600.0f && t > 18.0f) return BIOME_RAINFOREST;
    if (p > 800.0f && t > 5.0f)  return BIOME_TEMPERATE_FOREST;
    if (p > 450.0f && t > 18.0f) return BIOME_SAVANNA;
    if (p < 230.0f && t > 16.0f) return BIOME_DESERT;
    if (fabsf(lat) > 25.0f && fabsf(lat) < 48.0f && p >= 230.0f && p < 480.0f)
        return BIOME_MEDITERRANEAN;
    return BIOME_STEPPE;
}

const char *earth_biome_name(Biome b)
{
    switch (b) {
    case BIOME_ICE:              return "ЛЕДНИКИ";
    case BIOME_TUNDRA:           return "ТУНДРА";
    case BIOME_TAIGA:            return "ТАЙГА";
    case BIOME_TEMPERATE_FOREST: return "ЛЕС УМЕРЕННЫЙ";
    case BIOME_STEPPE:           return "СТЕПЬ";
    case BIOME_DESERT:           return "ПУСТЫНЯ";
    case BIOME_SAVANNA:          return "САВАННА";
    case BIOME_MEDITERRANEAN:    return "СРЕДИЗЕМНОМОРЬЕ";
    case BIOME_RAINFOREST:       return "ДЖУНГЛИ";
    default:                     return "ОКЕАН";
    }
}

const char *earth_zone_name(float lat)
{
    float a = fabsf(lat);
    if (a < 10.0f)  return "ЭКВАТОРИАЛЬНЫЙ";
    if (a < 24.0f)  return "ТРОПИЧЕСКИЙ";
    if (a < 34.0f)  return "СУБТРОПИЧЕСКИЙ";
    if (a < 46.0f)  return "УМЕРЕННЫЙ";
    if (a < 66.0f)  return "СУБПОЛЯРНЫЙ";
    return "ПОЛЯРНЫЙ";
}

static void blend3(float *c, const float *a, float t)
{
    c[0] = lerpf(c[0], a[0], t);
    c[1] = lerpf(c[1], a[1], t);
    c[2] = lerpf(c[2], a[2], t);
}

void earth_biome_color(Biome b, float lon, float lat, float elev, float day,
                       float *r, float *g, float *bl)
{
    static const float alb[BIOME_COUNT][3] = {
        { 0.92f, 0.93f, 0.97f }, /* ice    */
        { 0.60f, 0.58f, 0.53f }, /* tundra */
        { 0.21f, 0.33f, 0.18f }, /* taiga  */
        { 0.26f, 0.46f, 0.19f }, /* temper */
        { 0.66f, 0.60f, 0.28f }, /* steppe */
        { 0.83f, 0.73f, 0.46f }, /* desert */
        { 0.67f, 0.61f, 0.24f }, /* savanna*/
        { 0.53f, 0.58f, 0.27f }, /* medit  */
        { 0.15f, 0.38f, 0.11f }, /* jungle */
    };
    static const float snow[3] = { 0.93f, 0.95f, 0.98f };
    static const float brown[3] = { 0.60f, 0.48f, 0.26f };

    float c[3];
    float tex = 0.88f + 0.22f * fbm2(lon * 0.9f + 5.0f, lat * 0.9f - 3.0f, 2);
    c[0] = alb[b][0] * tex;
    c[1] = alb[b][1] * tex;
    c[2] = alb[b][2] * tex;

    /* seasonal vegetation: greener in the warm half of the year */
    float cyc = cosf(TWO_PI * (day - 172.0f) / 365.0f);
    float gseason = lat >= 0.0f ? 0.5f + 0.5f * cyc : 0.5f - 0.5f * cyc;
    if (b == BIOME_TAIGA || b == BIOME_TEMPERATE_FOREST ||
        b == BIOME_STEPPE || b == BIOME_SAVANNA || b == BIOME_MEDITERRANEAN) {
        float green = 0.35f + 0.65f * gseason;
        c[1] *= 1.0f + 0.30f * (green - 0.5f);
        c[0] *= 1.0f + 0.10f * (green - 0.5f);
    }

    /* dry season browning */
    if (b == BIOME_SAVANNA || b == BIOME_STEPPE || b == BIOME_MEDITERRANEAN) {
        float pn = precip_at(lon, lat, elev, day);
        float dry = clampf((180.0f - pn) / 180.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f) * 0.8f;
        blend3(c, brown, dry);
    }

    /* snow cover: by altitude + latitude + season */
    float dryf = 0.0f;
    if (b == BIOME_DESERT || b == BIOME_STEPPE)
        dryf = clampf(1.0f - precip_at(lon, lat, elev, day) / 90.0f, 0.0f, 0.4f);
    float sl = snowline_m(lat);
    float sn = smoothstepf(sl + 350.0f, sl, elev);
    sn = clampf(sn * (1.0f - dryf), 0.0f, 1.0f);
    if (b == BIOME_ICE)
        sn = 1.0f;

    /* polar land always snow-covered in winter */
    if (elev > 40.0f && gseason < 0.45f && fabsf(lat) > 66.0f)
        sn = maxf(sn, 0.55f);

    blend3(c, snow, sn);

    *r = c[0];
    *g = c[1];
    *bl = c[2];
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* weather                                                              */

void weather_init(void)
{
    int i;
    for (i = 0; i < MAX_STORMS; i++)
        storms[i].active = 0;
    belts_register();
    rivers_register();
}

void weather_update(float dt_days)
{
    static float next_spawn = 2.0f;
    int i, count = 0;

    for (i = 0; i < MAX_STORMS; i++)
        if (storms[i].active)
            count++;

    next_spawn -= dt_days;
    if (next_spawn <= 0.0f && count < MAX_STORMS) {
        int tries;
        for (tries = 0; tries < 8; tries++) {
            float lon = randf() * 360.0f - 180.0f;
            float lat = (randf() < 0.5f ? 1.0f : -1.0f) * (8.0f + randf() * 15.0f);
            if (earth_height(lon, lat) < -300.0f) {
                for (i = 0; i < MAX_STORMS; i++) {
                    if (!storms[i].active)
                        break;
                }
                if (i < MAX_STORMS) {
                    storms[i].active = 1;
                    storms[i].lon = lon;
                    storms[i].lat = lat;
                    storms[i].radius_deg = 3.0f + randf() * 4.0f;
                    storms[i].intensity = 0.35f + randf() * 0.3f;
                    storms[i].category = 1;
                    storms[i].life_day = 4.0f + randf() * 5.0f;
                    storms[i].wind_ms = 34.0f + randf() * 15.0f;
                    storms[i].bearing_deg = 270.0f + (lat >= 0 ? 15.0f : -15.0f);
                }
                break;
            }
        }
        next_spawn = 2.0f + randf() * 3.0f;
    }

    for (i = 0; i < MAX_STORMS; i++) {
        Storm *s = &storms[i];
        if (!s->active)
            continue;

        s->life_day -= dt_days;
        s->lon = wrap_lon(s->lon - 1.2f * dt_days);
        float pole = s->lat >= 0.0f ? 1.0f : -1.0f;
        s->lat += 0.25f * pole * dt_days;

        float phase = sinf((3.0f - s->life_day) * 0.6f);
        if (earth_height(s->lon, s->lat) > 0.0f)
            s->intensity -= 0.5f * dt_days;
        else
            s->intensity = clampf(s->intensity + 0.03f * phase * dt_days, 0.25f, 1.0f);

        s->wind_ms = 33.0f + 58.0f * s->intensity;
        int cat = 1 + (int)(s->intensity * 4.99f);
        if (cat > 5) cat = 5;
        s->category = cat;

        if (s->life_day <= 0.0f || s->intensity < 0.08f)
            s->active = 0;
    }
}

Storm earth_nearest_cyclone(float lon, float lat, float *dist_deg)
{
    Storm best;
    best.active = 0;
    float bd = 1e9f;
    int i;

    for (i = 0; i < MAX_STORMS; i++) {
        Storm *s = &storms[i];
        if (!s->active)
            continue;
        float dx = wrap_lon(s->lon - lon);
        float dy = s->lat - lat;
        float d = sqrtf(dx * dx + dy * dy);
        if (d < bd) {
            bd = d;
            best = *s;
        }
    }
    *dist_deg = bd;
    return best;
}

void game_tick(float real_dt)
{
    float mins = real_dt * GAME_MIN_PER_REAL_SEC;
    world_time.day_f += mins / 1440.0f;

    while (world_time.day_f >= 366.0f) {
        world_time.day_f -= 365.0f;
        world_time.year++;
    }
    if (world_time.day_f < 1.0f)
        world_time.day_f = 1.0f;

    int d = (int)world_time.day_f;
    if (d > 365) d = 365;
    world_time.day = d;

    float hfrac = (world_time.day_f - (float)d) * 24.0f;
    int h = (int)hfrac;
    if (h > 23) h = 23;
    world_time.hour = h;
    world_time.minute = (int)((hfrac - (float)h) * 60.0f);
}

Vec3 earth_sun_dir(float lat)
{
    float dl = 23.44f * DEG * sinf(TWO_PI * (world_time.day_f - 81.0f) / 365.0f);
    float lr = clamp_lat(lat) * DEG;
    float hour = world_time.hour + world_time.minute / 60.0f;
    float hr = (hour - 12.0f) * 15.0f * DEG;

    float sinel = sinf(dl) * sinf(lr) + cosf(dl) * cosf(lr) * cosf(hr);
    float el = asinf(clampf(sinel, -1.0f, 1.0f));
    float cel = cosf(el);
    float cosL = cosf(lr);

    float ca = 1.0f;
    if (cel > 1e-4f && cosL > 1e-4f)
        ca = (sinf(dl) - sinf(el) * sinf(lr)) / (cel * cosL);
    ca = clampf(ca, -1.0f, 1.0f);
    float sa = cel > 1e-4f ? cosf(dl) * sinf(hr) / cel : 0.0f;
    float az = atan2f(sa, ca);

    return v3(cel * sinf(az), sinf(el), cel * cosf(az));
}

void earth_light(float e, float rain,
                 float *ambient, float *diffuse,
                 float *top_r, float *top_g, float *top_b,
                 float *hor_r, float *hor_g, float *hor_b)
{
    float t = smoothstepf(-0.18f, 0.12f, e);
    float tn = smoothstepf(-0.18f, -0.05f, e);

    float dr = 88.0f, dg = 150.0f, db = 230.0f;
    float dh = 190.0f, dhh = 212.0f, dhb = 236.0f;
    float nr = 6.0f, ng = 10.0f, nb = 26.0f;
    float nh = 10.0f, nhh = 16.0f, nhb = 42.0f;
    float tr2 = 36.0f + 52.0f * (1.0f - tn), tg = 30.0f + 30.0f * tn, tb = 44.0f + 70.0f * tn;
    float thr = 250.0f, thg = 150.0f, thb = 60.0f;

    float top_c[3] = { lerpf(nr, tr2, tn), lerpf(ng, tg, tn), lerpf(nb, tb, tn) };
    float hor_c[3] = { lerpf(nh, thr, tn), lerpf(nhh, thg, tn), lerpf(nhb, thb, tn) };

    top_c[0] = lerpf(top_c[0], dr, t);
    top_c[1] = lerpf(top_c[1], dg, t);
    top_c[2] = lerpf(top_c[2], db, t);
    hor_c[0] = lerpf(hor_c[0], dh, t);
    hor_c[1] = lerpf(hor_c[1], dhh, t);
    hor_c[2] = lerpf(hor_c[2], dhb, t);

    *ambient = lerpf(0.10f, 0.42f, t);
    *diffuse = lerpf(0.06f, 0.80f, t);

    if (rain > 0.0f) {
        float g2[3] = { 0.78f, 0.79f, 0.80f };
        top_c[0] = lerpf(top_c[0], g2[0] * 120.0f, rain);
        top_c[1] = lerpf(top_c[1], g2[1] * 120.0f, rain);
        top_c[2] = lerpf(top_c[2], g2[2] * 120.0f, rain);
        hor_c[0] = lerpf(hor_c[0], g2[0] * 130.0f, rain);
        hor_c[1] = lerpf(hor_c[1], g2[1] * 130.0f, rain);
        hor_c[2] = lerpf(hor_c[2], g2[2] * 130.0f, rain);
        *ambient -= 0.12f * rain;
        *diffuse -= 0.35f * rain;
        if (*ambient < 0.05f) *ambient = 0.05f;
        if (*diffuse < 0.05f) *diffuse = 0.05f;
    }

    *top_r = top_c[0];
    *top_g = top_c[1];
    *top_b = top_c[2];
    *hor_r = hor_c[0];
    *hor_g = hor_c[1];
    *hor_b = hor_c[2];
}

#ifndef GMATH_H
#define GMATH_H

#include <math.h>

#define PI 3.14159265358979323846f

typedef struct {
    float x, y, z;
} Vec3;

static inline Vec3 v3(float x, float y, float z)
{
    Vec3 r = { x, y, z };
    return r;
}

static inline Vec3 v3add(Vec3 a, Vec3 b)
{
    return v3(a.x + b.x, a.y + b.y, a.z + b.z);
}

static inline Vec3 v3sub(Vec3 a, Vec3 b)
{
    return v3(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y, a.z - b.z);
}

static inline Vec3 v3scale(Vec3 a, float s)
{
    return v3(a.x * s, a.y * s, a.z * s);
}

static inline float v3dot(Vec3 a, Vec3 b)
{
    return a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z;
}

static inline Vec3 v3cross(Vec3 a, Vec3 b)
{
    return v3(a.y * b.z - a.z * b.y,
              a.z * b.x - a.x * b.z,
              a.x * b.y - a.y * b.x);
}

static inline float v3len(Vec3 a)
{
    return sqrtf(v3dot(a, a));
}

static inline Vec3 v3norm(Vec3 a)
{
    float l = v3len(a);
    if (l < 1e-8f)
        return v3(0, 0, 0);
    return v3scale(a, 1.0f / l);
}

static inline float clampf(float x, float a, float b)
{
    if (x < a) return a;
    if (x > b) return b;
    return x;
}

static inline float lerpf(float a, float b, float t)
{
    return a + (b - a) * t;
}

static inline float smoothstepf(float e0, float e1, float x)
{
    float t = clampf((x - e0) / (e1 - e0), 0.0f, 1.0f);
    return t * t * (3.0f - 2.0f * t);
}

static inline float minf(float a, float b) { return a < b ? a : b; }
static inline float maxf(float a, float b) { return a > b ? a : b; }

#endif

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>

#include <X11/Xlib.h>
#include <X11/Xutil.h>
#include <X11/keysym.h>

#include "renderer.h"
#include "earth.h"
#include "noise.h"

#define WIN_W 1920
#define WIN_H 1080
#define RENDER_W 960
#define RENDER_H 540

#define MOUSE_SENS 0.0010f
#define MOUSE_JUMP_CLAMP 150

#define EYE_HEIGHT 1.7f
#define GRAVITY 22.0f
#define JUMP_SPEED 8.5f
#define WALK_SPEED 7.0f
#define RUN_SPEED 14.0f

#define BANNER_TIME 4.0f

typedef struct {
    Vec3 pos;
    Vec3 vel;
    float yaw;
    float pitch;
    int grounded;
} Player;

static int mask_shift(unsigned long m)
{
    int s = 0;
    if (!m)
        return 0;
    while (!(m & 1)) {
        m >>= 1;
        s++;
    }
    return s;
}

static int mask_size(unsigned long m)
{
    int n = 0;
    if (!m)
        return 0;
    while (!(m & 1))
        m >>= 1;
    while (m & 1) {
        n++;
        m >>= 1;
    }
    return n;
}

static double now_sec(void)
{
    struct timespec ts;
    clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
    return (double)ts.tv_sec + (double)ts.tv_nsec * 1e-9;
}

static int key_down(Display *dpy, KeyCode kc)
{
    char keys[32];
    if (!kc)
        return 0;
    XQueryKeymap(dpy, keys);
    return (keys[kc / 8] >> (kc % 8)) & 1;
}

static Cursor make_blank_cursor(Display *dpy, Window win)
{
    Pixmap pm;
    GC gc;
    XGCValues gv;
    XColor col;
    Cursor cur;

    pm = XCreatePixmap(dpy, win, 1, 1, 1);
    gc = XCreateGC(dpy, pm, 0, NULL);
    memset(&gv, 0, sizeof(gv));
    gv.foreground = 0;
    XChangeGC(dpy, gc, GCForeground, &gv);
    XDrawPoint(dpy, pm, gc, 0, 0);

    memset(&col, 0, sizeof(col));
    col.flags = DoRed | DoGreen | DoBlue;
    cur = XCreatePixmapCursor(dpy, pm, pm, &col, &col, 0, 0);

    XFreeGC(dpy, gc);
    XFreePixmap(dpy, pm);
    return cur;
}

static Camera player_camera(const Player *p)
{
    Camera cam;
    cam.pos = p->pos;
    cam.yaw = p->yaw;
    cam.pitch = p->pitch;
    cam.fov = 1.15f;
    return cam;
}

static void player_init(Player *p)
{
    float px = 0.0f, pz = -30.0f;
    int rad = 0;
    while (rad < 400) {
        if (earth_height(px, pz) > 3.0f)
            break;
        px += 3.0f;
        if (px > 180.0f) {
            px = -180.0f;
            pz += 2.0f;
        }
        rad += 3;
    }
    p->pos = v3(px, earth_height(px, pz) + EYE_HEIGHT, pz);
    p->vel = v3(0, 0, 0);
    p->yaw = 0.35f;
    p->pitch = -0.10f;
    p->grounded = 1;
    printf("Spawn: lon=%.1f lat=%.1f h=%.0fm\n",
           px, pz, earth_height(px, pz));
}

static void player_physics(Player *p, float move_x, float move_z,
                           int jump, int run, float dt)
{
    float speed = run ? RUN_SPEED : WALK_SPEED;
    float sy = sinf(p->yaw);
    float cy = cosf(p->yaw);

    Vec3 fwd = v3(sy, 0.0f, cy);
    Vec3 right = v3(cy, 0.0f, -sy);
    Vec3 wish = v3add(v3scale(fwd, move_z), v3scale(right, move_x));

    if (v3dot(wish, wish) > 1e-6f)
        wish = v3scale(v3norm(wish), speed);

    p->vel.x = wish.x;
    p->vel.z = wish.z;

    p->vel.y -= GRAVITY * dt;

    p->pos.x += p->vel.x * dt;
    p->pos.y += p->vel.y * dt;
    p->pos.z += p->vel.z * dt;

    float ground = earth_height(p->pos.x, p->pos.z);
    float surface = ground > 0.0f ? ground : 0.0f;

    if (p->pos.y <= surface + EYE_HEIGHT) {
        p->pos.y = surface + EYE_HEIGHT;
        p->vel.y = 0.0f;
        p->grounded = 1;
    } else {
        p->grounded = 0;
    }

    if (jump && p->grounded) {
        p->vel.y = JUMP_SPEED;
        p->grounded = 0;
    }
}

static void upscale(const uint32_t *src, int sw, int sh,
                    uint32_t *dst, int dw, int dh)
{
    int x, y;
    for (y = 0; y < dh; y++) {
        float fy = (float)y * (sh - 1) / (dh - 1);
        int y0 = (int)fy;
        int y1 = y0 + 1 < sh ? y0 + 1 : y0;
        float vy = fy - y0;
        for (x = 0; x < dw; x++) {
            float fx = (float)x * (sw - 1) / (dw - 1);
            int x0 = (int)fx;
            int x1 = x0 + 1 < sw ? x0 + 1 : x0;
            float ux = fx - x0;

            const uint32_t a = src[y0 * sw + x0];
            const uint32_t b = src[y0 * sw + x1];
            const uint32_t c = src[y1 * sw + x0];
            const uint32_t e = src[y1 * sw + x1];

            float rr = (a >> 16 & 255) * (1 - ux) * (1 - vy)
                     + (b >> 16 & 255) * ux * (1 - vy)
                     + (c >> 16 & 255) * (1 - ux) * vy
                     + (e >> 16 & 255) * ux * vy;
            float gg = (a >> 8 & 255) * (1 - ux) * (1 - vy)
                     + (b >> 8 & 255) * ux * (1 - vy)
                     + (c >> 8 & 255) * (1 - ux) * vy
                     + (e >> 8 & 255) * ux * vy;
            float bl = (a & 255) * (1 - ux) * (1 - vy)
                     + (b & 255) * ux * (1 - vy)
                     + (c & 255) * (1 - ux) * vy
                     + (e & 255) * ux * vy;

            dst[y * dw + x] = 0xFF000000u
                            | ((uint32_t)rr << 16)
                            | ((uint32_t)gg << 8)
                            | (uint32_t)bl;
        }
    }
}

static void upscale_packed(const uint32_t *src, int sw, int sh,
                           uint32_t *dst, int dw, int dh,
                           int rs, int gs, int bs,
                           int rl, int gl, int bl)
{
    int x, y;
    for (y = 0; y < dh; y++) {
        float fy = (float)y * (sh - 1) / (dh - 1);
        int y0 = (int)fy;
        int y1 = y0 + 1 < sh ? y0 + 1 : y0;
        float vy = fy - y0;
        for (x = 0; x < dw; x++) {
            float fx = (float)x * (sw - 1) / (dw - 1);
            int x0 = (int)fx;
            int x1 = x0 + 1 < sw ? x0 + 1 : x0;
            float ux = fx - x0;

            const uint32_t a = src[y0 * sw + x0];
            const uint32_t b = src[y0 * sw + x1];
            const uint32_t c = src[y1 * sw + x0];
            const uint32_t e = src[y1 * sw + x1];

            unsigned r = (unsigned)((a >> 16 & 255) * (1 - ux) * (1 - vy)
                          + (b >> 16 & 255) * ux * (1 - vy)
                          + (c >> 16 & 255) * (1 - ux) * vy
                          + (e >> 16 & 255) * ux * vy);
            unsigned g = (unsigned)((a >> 8 & 255) * (1 - ux) * (1 - vy)
                          + (b >> 8 & 255) * ux * (1 - vy)
                          + (c >> 8 & 255) * (1 - ux) * vy
                          + (e >> 8 & 255) * ux * vy);
            unsigned b2 = (unsigned)((a & 255) * (1 - ux) * (1 - vy)
                          + (b & 255) * ux * (1 - vy)
                          + (c & 255) * (1 - ux) * vy
                          + (e & 255) * ux * vy);

            unsigned out = 0;
            out |= (rl >= 8 ? (r >> (rl - 8)) : (r << (8 - rl))) << rs;
            out |= (gl >= 8 ? (g >> (gl - 8)) : (g << (8 - gl))) << gs;
            out |= (bl >= 8 ? (b2 >> (bl - 8)) : (b2 << (8 - bl))) << bs;
            dst[y * dw + x] = out;
        }
    }
}

static int font_ready = 0;
static XFontSet hud_font = NULL;
static XFontStruct *hud_font_struct = NULL;

static void hud_init(Display *dpy)
{
    char **missing;
    int n_missing;
    char *default_string;
    char pat[] = "-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-iso10646-1";
    hud_font = XCreateFontSet(dpy, pat, &missing, &n_missing, &default_string);
    if (hud_font) {
        font_ready = 1;
        return;
    }
    hud_font_struct = XLoadQueryFont(dpy, "fixed");
    if (hud_font_struct)
        font_ready = 1;
}

static void hud_text(Display *dpy, Window win, GC gc, int x, int y,
                     unsigned long color, const char *s)
{
    XSetForeground(dpy, gc, 0x000000);
    if (hud_font)
        Xutf8DrawString(dpy, win, hud_font, gc, x + 1, y + 1, s, (int)strlen(s));
    else if (hud_font_struct)
        XDrawString(dpy, win, gc, x + 1, y + 1, s, (int)strlen(s));

    XSetForeground(dpy, gc, color);
    if (hud_font)
        Xutf8DrawString(dpy, win, hud_font, gc, x, y, s, (int)strlen(s));
    else if (hud_font_struct)
        XDrawString(dpy, win, gc, x, y, s, (int)strlen(s));
}

static void print_controls(void)
{
    printf("Anti-world - Земля: климат, океаны, циклоны, день/ночь\n");
    printf("Resolution: %dx%d (render %dx%d)\n", WIN_W, WIN_H, RENDER_W, RENDER_H);
    printf("Controls:\n");
    printf("  WASD - move | Shift - run | Space - jump\n");
    printf("  Arrows - look | LMB - grab mouse | RMB - release | ESC - quit\n");
    printf("Bench: ./antiworld --bench [N] --out file.ppm\n");
}

int main(int argc, char **argv)
{
    int i;
    int bench = 0;
    const char *out_path = "shot.ppm";

    for (i = 1; i < argc; i++) {
        if (!strcmp(argv[i], "--bench") && i + 1 < argc) {
            bench = atoi(argv[++i]);
            if (bench < 1)
                bench = 1;
        } else if (!strcmp(argv[i], "--out") && i + 1 < argc) {
            out_path = argv[++i];
        }
    }

    noise_init(20260923u);
    weather_init();

    world_time.year = 0;
    world_time.day = 1;
    world_time.hour = 8;
    world_time.minute = 0;
    world_time.day_f = 1.0f + 8.0f / 24.0f;

    Image img;
    if (!img_init(&img, RENDER_W, RENDER_H)) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Failed to allocate framebuffer\n");
        return 1;
    }

    uint32_t *fb_full = (uint32_t *)malloc((size_t)WIN_W * WIN_H * sizeof(uint32_t));
    if (!fb_full) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Failed to allocate full framebuffer\n");
        img_free(&img);
        return 1;
    }

    Player player;
    player_init(&player);
    chunks_update(player.pos.x, player.pos.z);

    if (bench > 0) {
        Camera cam = player_camera(&player);
        LightState ls;
        memset(&ls, 0, sizeof(ls));
        world_time.day = 165;
        world_time.hour = 12;
        world_time.day_f = 165.5f;
        Vec3 sun = earth_sun_dir(player.pos.z);
        float el = asinf(clampf(sun.y, -1.0f, 1.0f));
        float amb, df;
        earth_light(el, 0.0f, &amb, &df, &ls.sky_top_r, &ls.sky_top_g,
                    &ls.sky_top_b, &ls.fog_r, &ls.fog_g, &ls.fog_b);
        ls.ambient = amb;
        ls.diffuse = df;
        ls.sun = sun;
        ls.water_time = 0.0f;
        for (i = 0; i < bench; i++) {
            cam.yaw = player.yaw + (float)i * 0.02f;
            ls.water_time = (float)i * 0.4f;
            render_frame(&img, &cam, &ls);
        }
        upscale(img.pixels, img.w, img.h, fb_full, WIN_W, WIN_H);
        write_ppm(out_path, fb_full, WIN_W, WIN_H);
        printf("Bench: %d frames, %d chunks -> %s (%dx%d)\n",
               bench, chunks_loaded(), out_path, WIN_W, WIN_H);
        chunks_unload_all();
        img_free(&img);
        free(fb_full);
        return 0;
    }

    Display *dpy = XOpenDisplay(NULL);
    if (!dpy) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Cannot open X11 display\n");
        chunks_unload_all();
        img_free(&img);
        free(fb_full);
        return 1;
    }

    int screen = DefaultScreen(dpy);
    Visual *visual = DefaultVisual(dpy, screen);
    int depth = DefaultDepth(dpy, screen);
    Window root = RootWindow(dpy, screen);

    int rs = mask_shift(visual->red_mask);
    int gs = mask_shift(visual->green_mask);
    int bs = mask_shift(visual->blue_mask);
    int rl = mask_size(visual->red_mask);
    int gl = mask_size(visual->green_mask);
    int bl = mask_size(visual->blue_mask);

    Window win = XCreateSimpleWindow(dpy, root, 0, 0, WIN_W, WIN_H, 0,
                                     BlackPixel(dpy, screen),
                                     BlackPixel(dpy, screen));
    XStoreName(dpy, win, "Anti-world");
    XSelectInput(dpy, win,
                 ExposureMask | KeyPressMask | KeyReleaseMask |
                 ButtonPressMask | ButtonReleaseMask | PointerMotionMask);

    XSizeHints hints;
    memset(&hints, 0, sizeof(hints));
    hints.flags = PMinSize | PMaxSize;
    hints.min_width = hints.max_width = WIN_W;
    hints.min_height = hints.max_height = WIN_H;
    XSetWMNormalHints(dpy, win, &hints);

    Atom wm_delete = XInternAtom(dpy, "WM_DELETE_WINDOW", False);
    XSetWMProtocols(dpy, win, &wm_delete, 1);

    XMapWindow(dpy, win);

    XImage *ximg = XCreateImage(dpy, visual, depth, ZPixmap, 0,
                                NULL, WIN_W, WIN_H, 32, WIN_W * 4);
    if (!ximg) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Failed to create XImage\n");
        chunks_unload_all();
        XDestroyWindow(dpy, win);
        XCloseDisplay(dpy);
        img_free(&img);
        free(fb_full);
        return 1;
    }
    ximg->data = (char *)malloc((size_t)WIN_W * WIN_H * sizeof(uint32_t));
    if (!ximg->data) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Failed to allocate XImage data\n");
        chunks_unload_all();
        XDestroyImage(ximg);
        XDestroyWindow(dpy, win);
        XCloseDisplay(dpy);
        img_free(&img);
        free(fb_full);
        return 1;
    }

    GC gc = XCreateGC(dpy, win, 0, NULL);
    Cursor blank_cursor = make_blank_cursor(dpy, win);
    hud_init(dpy);

    KeyCode kc_esc = XKeysymToKeycode(dpy, XK_Escape);
    KeyCode kc_w = XKeysymToKeycode(dpy, XK_w);
    KeyCode kc_a = XKeysymToKeycode(dpy, XK_a);
    KeyCode kc_s = XKeysymToKeycode(dpy, XK_s);
    KeyCode kc_d = XKeysymToKeycode(dpy, XK_d);
    KeyCode kc_space = XKeysymToKeycode(dpy, XK_space);
    KeyCode kc_shift = XKeysymToKeycode(dpy, XK_Shift_L);
    KeyCode kc_shift_r = XKeysymToKeycode(dpy, XK_Shift_R);
    KeyCode kc_up = XKeysymToKeycode(dpy, XK_Up);
    KeyCode kc_down = XKeysymToKeycode(dpy, XK_Down);
    KeyCode kc_left = XKeysymToKeycode(dpy, XK_Left);
    KeyCode kc_right = XKeysymToKeycode(dpy, XK_Right);

    int running = 1;
    int grabbed = 0;
    int first_motion = 0;
    int latest_mx = 0, latest_my = 0;
    double start_time = now_sec();
    double last = start_time;
    double fps_timer = start_time;
    int frames = 0;
    char title[80];
    int banner_timer = 0; /* game minutes the banner is shown */
    char banner_text[128];
    banner_text[0] = '\0';

    print_controls();

    while (running) {
        while (XPending(dpy)) {
            XEvent e;
            XNextEvent(dpy, &e);

            switch (e.type) {
            case ClientMessage:
                if ((Atom)e.xclient.data.l[0] == wm_delete)
                    running = 0;
                break;

            case ButtonPress:
                if (e.xbutton.button == Button1 && !grabbed) {
                    XGrabPointer(dpy, win, True,
                                 ButtonPressMask | ButtonReleaseMask |
                                 PointerMotionMask,
                                 GrabModeAsync, GrabModeAsync,
                                 win, None, CurrentTime);
                    latest_mx = WIN_W / 2;
                    latest_my = WIN_H / 2;
                    XDefineCursor(dpy, win, blank_cursor);
                    grabbed = 1;
                    first_motion = 1;
                } else if (e.xbutton.button == Button3 && grabbed) {
                    XUngrabPointer(dpy, CurrentTime);
                    XUndefineCursor(dpy, win);
                    grabbed = 0;
                }
                break;

            case MotionNotify:
                if (grabbed) {
                    latest_mx = e.xmotion.x;
                    latest_my = e.xmotion.y;
                }
                break;
            }
        }

        if (key_down(dpy, kc_esc))
            running = 0;

        double t = now_sec();
        float real_dt = (float)(t - last);
        last = t;
        if (real_dt > 0.05f)
            real_dt = 0.05f;

        int prev_day = world_time.day;
        int prev_month = (world_time.day - 1) / 30;
        game_tick(real_dt);
        if (world_time.day != prev_day) {
            snprintf(banner_text, sizeof(banner_text),
                     "ДЕНЬ %d  |  ГОД %d", world_time.day, world_time.year);
            banner_timer = 8;
            printf("== новый день: %d день %d год ==\n",
                   world_time.day, world_time.year);
        }
        if (banner_timer > 0)
            banner_timer--;

        if ((world_time.day - 1) / 30 != prev_month) {
            /* season shifted: ice/snow extents change, rebuild the world */
            chunks_unload_all();
        }

        float dt_days = real_dt * 6.0f / 1440.0f;
        weather_update(dt_days);

        if (grabbed) {
            int dx = latest_mx - WIN_W / 2;
            int dy = latest_my - WIN_H / 2;
            if (dx > MOUSE_JUMP_CLAMP) dx = MOUSE_JUMP_CLAMP;
            if (dx < -MOUSE_JUMP_CLAMP) dx = -MOUSE_JUMP_CLAMP;
            if (dy > MOUSE_JUMP_CLAMP) dy = MOUSE_JUMP_CLAMP;
            if (dy < -MOUSE_JUMP_CLAMP) dy = -MOUSE_JUMP_CLAMP;

            if (first_motion) {
                first_motion = 0;
            } else if (dx != 0 || dy != 0) {
                player.yaw += (float)dx * MOUSE_SENS;
                player.pitch -= (float)dy * MOUSE_SENS;
            }
            player.pitch = clampf(player.pitch, -1.5f, 1.5f);
            XWarpPointer(dpy, None, win, 0, 0, 0, 0,
                         WIN_W / 2, WIN_H / 2);
            latest_mx = WIN_W / 2;
            latest_my = WIN_H / 2;
        }

        float move_x = 0.0f;
        float move_z = 0.0f;
        if (key_down(dpy, kc_w)) move_z += 1.0f;
        if (key_down(dpy, kc_s)) move_z -= 1.0f;
        if (key_down(dpy, kc_a)) move_x -= 1.0f;
        if (key_down(dpy, kc_d)) move_x += 1.0f;

        int jump = key_down(dpy, kc_space);
        int run = key_down(dpy, kc_shift) || key_down(dpy, kc_shift_r);

        player_physics(&player, move_x, move_z, jump, run, real_dt);

        float look = 0.9f * real_dt;
        if (key_down(dpy, kc_left))  player.yaw -= look;
        if (key_down(dpy, kc_right)) player.yaw += look;
        if (key_down(dpy, kc_up))    player.pitch += look;
        if (key_down(dpy, kc_down))  player.pitch -= look;
        player.pitch = clampf(player.pitch, -1.5f, 1.5f);

        chunks_update(player.pos.x, player.pos.z);

        float elon = player.pos.x;
        float elat = player.pos.z;
        float elev = earth_height(elon, elat);
        float ground_alt = elev > 0.0f ? elev : 0.0f;

        float precip = earth_precip_mmday(elon, elat, ground_alt);
        float rain = clampf(precip / 140.0f, 0.0f, 0.7f);

        Vec3 sun = earth_sun_dir(elat);
        float el = asinf(clampf(sun.y, -1.0f, 1.0f));

        LightState ls;
        memset(&ls, 0, sizeof(ls));
        earth_light(el, rain, &ls.ambient, &ls.diffuse,
                    &ls.sky_top_r, &ls.sky_top_g, &ls.sky_top_b,
                    &ls.fog_r, &ls.fog_g, &ls.fog_b);
        ls.sun = sun;
        ls.water_time = (float)(t - start_time) * 0.35f;

        Camera cam = player_camera(&player);
        render_frame(&img, &cam, &ls);
        upscale_packed(img.pixels, img.w, img.h,
                       (uint32_t *)ximg->data, WIN_W, WIN_H,
                       rs, gs, bs, rl, gl, bl);
        XPutImage(dpy, win, gc, ximg, 0, 0, 0, 0, WIN_W, WIN_H);

        /* HUD */
        {
            char line[160];
            unsigned long col_text = 0xEFEFFF;
            unsigned long col_banner = 0xFFD060;
            int y = 20;
            int xm = 24;

            snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "ДЕНЬ %d  ·  %02d:%02d  ·  ГОД %d",
                     world_time.day, world_time.hour, world_time.minute,
                     world_time.year);
            hud_text(dpy, win, gc, xm, y, col_text, line);
            y += 18;

            snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "ПОЗИЦИЯ: %+.1f %c  %+.1f %c  ·  ВЫСОТА: %+.0f м",
                     elon, elon >= 0.0f ? 'E' : 'W',
                     elat, elat >= 0.0f ? 'N' : 'S', elev);
            hud_text(dpy, win, gc, xm, y, col_text, line);
            y += 18;

            {
                Biome b = earth_biome(elon, elat, elev > 0.0f ? elev : 0.0f);
                snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "МЕСТНОСТЬ: %s%s",
                         earth_biome_name(b),
                         earth_sea_ice(elon, elat) ? " · ЛЬДЫ" : "");
            }
            hud_text(dpy, win, gc, xm, y, col_text, line);
            y += 18;

            snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "ПОГОДА: дождь %d%%",
                     (int)(rain * 100.0f));
            hud_text(dpy, win, gc, xm, y, col_text, line);

            if (banner_timer > 0 && banner_text[0]) {
                int bx = WIN_W / 2 - 180;
                int by = WIN_H / 2;
                hud_text(dpy, win, gc, bx + 2, by + 2, 0x0000A0, banner_text);
                hud_text(dpy, win, gc, bx, by, col_banner, banner_text);
            }
        }

        frames++;
        if (t - fps_timer >= 0.5) {
            double fps = frames / (t - fps_timer);
            snprintf(title, sizeof(title),
                     "Anti-world - %.0f FPS - %d chunks - д.%d г.%d",
                     fps, chunks_loaded(), world_time.day, world_time.year);
            XStoreName(dpy, win, title);
            frames = 0;
            fps_timer = t;
        }

        XFlush(dpy);

        double frame_time = now_sec() - t;
        if (frame_time < 1.0 / 60.0) {
            struct timespec ts;
            double sleep_s = 1.0 / 60.0 - frame_time;
            ts.tv_sec = (time_t)sleep_s;
            ts.tv_nsec = (long)((sleep_s - (double)ts.tv_sec) * 1e9);
            nanosleep(&ts, NULL);
        }
    }

    if (grabbed)
        XUngrabPointer(dpy, CurrentTime);

    XFreeGC(dpy, gc);
    free(ximg->data);
    ximg->data = NULL;
    XDestroyImage(ximg);
    XFreeCursor(dpy, blank_cursor);
    XDestroyWindow(dpy, win);
    XCloseDisplay(dpy);
    chunks_unload_all();
    img_free(&img);
    free(fb_full);

    printf("Bye.\n");
    return 0;
}

#include "noise.h"
#include "gmath.h"

static int perm[512];

void noise_init(unsigned seed)
{
    int i;
    int p[256];

    for (i = 0; i < 256; i++)
        p[i] = i;

    for (i = 255; i > 0; i--) {
        seed = seed * 1664525u + 1013904223u;
        int j = (int)(seed % (unsigned)(i + 1));
        int t = p[i];
        p[i] = p[j];
        p[j] = t;
    }

    for (i = 0; i < 512; i++)
        perm[i] = p[i & 255];
}

static float fade(float t)
{
    return t * t * t * (t * (t * 6.0f - 15.0f) + 10.0f);
}

static float grad(int hash, float x, float y)
{
    switch (hash & 3) {
    case 0:  return  x + y;
    case 1:  return -x + y;
    case 2:  return  x - y;
    default: return -x - y;
    }
}

float perlin2(float x, float y)
{
    float fx = floorf(x);
    float fy = floorf(y);
    int X = ((int)fx) & 255;
    int Y = ((int)fy) & 255;

    float xf = x - fx;
    float yf = y - fy;

    float u = fade(xf);
    float v = fade(yf);

    int aa = perm[perm[X] + Y];
    int ba = perm[perm[X + 1] + Y];
    int ab = perm[perm[X] + Y + 1];
    int bb = perm[perm[X + 1] + Y + 1];

    float x1 = lerpf(grad(aa, xf, yf),       grad(ba, xf - 1.0f, yf),       u);
    float x2 = lerpf(grad(ab, xf, yf - 1.0f), grad(bb, xf - 1.0f, yf - 1.0f), u);

    return lerpf(x1, x2, v);
}

float fbm2(float x, float y, int octaves)
{
    float sum = 0.0f;
    float amp = 0.5f;
    float tot = 0.0f;
    int i;

    for (i = 0; i < octaves; i++) {
        sum += amp * perlin2(x, y);
        tot += amp;
        amp *= 0.5f;
        x *= 2.0f;
        y *= 2.0f;
    }

    return sum / tot;
}

FILE: Anti-world/src/renderer.c
